introHtml: Custom 12 oz wine tumblers strike the ideal balance between a standard serving and portability. Whether you're outfitting a company picnic or stocking a hospitality suite, this size holds a generous pour without the weight of larger options. Many 12 oz models feature vacuum insulation to keep white wines chilled, and plastic versions are event-friendly for outdoor venues. Choose from stemless designs, like the Corkcicle® Stemless Wine Cup, for a modern look that's easy to imprint with your logo.
heroAltText: Custom 12 oz wine tumblers with company logo, perfect for corporate events and branded giveaways.
